summary: The failures both involve payload mutation: replacing an existing key returns its old value, and erase reports that keys are absent after copy-on-write. The supplied excerpts show Status delegates mutation to StatusRep, but omit the current StatusRep clone, set, and erase implementations needed to identify the repair.
hypotheses: StatusRep cloning or copy-on-write preparation fails to preserve payload entries, so mutations operate on an incomplete or stale payload collection.
StatusRep::SetPayload fails to replace the value associated with an existing type URL.
StatusRep::ErasePayload searches or updates the payload collection incorrectly after cloning.
